name: ToolsGroup
summary: Enterprise supply chain planning software, sold as SO99+, JustEnough and a platform the vendor calls Decion. It claims probabilistic demand forecasting with a full probability distribution for every SKU-location, multi-echelon inventory optimization against per-class service targets, and replenishment that recommends when, where and how much to reorder. Two scm planning jobs are claimed from the vendor's own pages, element by element in the profile; nothing is measured and no vendor number enters a machine-readable field.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-13, no credentials: www.toolsgroup.com serves a hand-written llms.txt (200), while docs.toolsgroup.com and support.toolsgroup.com both answer a Cloudflare managed challenge (403, cf-mitigated: challenge). No public API docs; no MCP server (mcp.toolsgroup.com has no address record).

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim for probabilistic demand forecasting: "Full probability distributions for every SKU-location", generated by continuously analyzing historical demand, seasonality, promotions and external signals. Item and location level; the accuracy figures the vendor prints stay in the profile.

Vendor's claim for replenishment, which "Recommends when, where, and how much stock to replenish based on demand, inventory, and service targets", with the service/stock trade-off claimed on the MEIO page: "Reduce excess inventory while maintaining strong customer service".
